title: fix: exclude voodoohop from quest leaderboards
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes voodoohop from the monthly quest standings and public GitHub quest leaderboard.
- Keeps rewards and balances unchanged.
- Adds a regression test for both views.

gist.headline: More room on the leaderboard
gist.blurb: The monthly quest standings and public GitHub quest leaderboard leave voodoohop off the board. Rewards and balances stay exactly where they are.
gist.summary: Excludes voodoohop from the monthly quest standings and public GitHub quest leaderboard, with regression tests for both views and no changes to rewards or balances.
gist.impact: Quest participants get standings without voodoohop in either view; earned Pollen and wallet balances remain unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict two small leaderboard boards for monthly quests and GitHub quests in a flower-filled garden. Polli, wearing a tiny scorekeeper visor, tends the boards while other contributors' names have room to be seen; a nearby Pollen jar remains untouched.
